an5.38:1.3: Ye te bhikkhave loke santo sappurisā, te saddhaṃ yeva paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ,
an5.38:1.4: saddhaṃ yeva paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ,
an5.38:1.5: saddhass'eva paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhantā paṭiggaṇhanti, no tathā assaddhassa,
an5.38:1.6: saddhass'eva paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā desenti, no tathā assaddhassa.
an5.38:1.7: Saddho kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
an5.38:1.8: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca saddhe kulaputte ānisaṃsā. 3.
an5.38:2.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe mahānigrodho samantā pakkhīnaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ hoti,
an5.38:2.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave saddho kulaputto bahuno janassa paṭisaraṇaṃ hoti bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānan ti.
